arxiv-2006-11710.title: Rotational properties of annulus dusty plasma in a strong magnetic field
arxiv-2006-11710.creator: Mangilal Choudhary, Roman Bergert, Sandra Moritz, Slobodan Mitic, Markus H. Thoma
arxiv-2006-11710.description: Abstract The collective dynamics of annulus dusty plasma formed between a co-centric conducting (non-conducting) disk and ring configuration is studied in a strongly magnetized radio-frequency (rf) discharge. A superconducting electromagnet is used to introduce a homogeneous magnetic field to the dusty plasma medium. In absence of the magnetic field, dust grains exhibit thermal motion around their equilibrium position.

arxiv-2102-05611.title: Optimal observables and estimators for practical superresolution imaging
arxiv-2102-05611.creator: Giacomo Sorelli, Manuel Gessner, Mattia Walschaers, Nicolas Treps
arxiv-2102-05611.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Giacomo Sorelli, Manuel Gessner, Mattia Walschaers, Nicolas Treps. Recent works identified resolution limits for the distance between incoherent point sources. However, it remains unclear how to choose suitable observables and estimators to reach these limits in practical situations. Here, we show how estimators saturating the Cramér-Rao bound for the distance between two thermal point sources can be constructed using an optimally designed observable in the presence of practical imperfections, such as misalignment, crosstalk and detector noise.

arxiv-2103-05711.title: Incremental Relaying for Power Line Communication: Performance Analysis and Power Allocation
arxiv-2103-05711.creator: Ankit Dubey, Chinmoy Kundu, Telex M. N. Ngatched, Octavia A. Dobre, Ranjan K. Mallik
arxiv-2103-05711.description: Abstract In this paper, incremental decode-and-forward (IDF) and incremental selective decode-and-forward (ISDF) relaying are proposed to improve the spectral efficiency of power line communication. Contrary to the traditional decode-and-forward (DF) relaying, IDF and ISDF strategies utilize the relay only if the direct link ceases to attain a certain information rate, thereby improving the spectral efficiency.

arxiv-2402-15611.creator: Giacomo Albi, Sara Bicego, Michael Herty, Yuyang Huang, Dante Kalise, Chiara Segala
arxiv-2402-15611.description: Abstract Feedback control synthesis for large-scale particle systems is reviewed in the framework of model predictive control (MPC). Two alternatives to MPC are proposed.

pmc-11483905.creator: Hamed Zarei, Marco Buchignani, Simone Giangrandi, Marco Paggi
pmc-11483905.description: The proposed integrated experimental and simulation study focuses on the mechanical behavior and failure analysis of coupled paper–aluminum (paper–Al) laminates for sustainable packaging. The research employs an innovative experimental approach combining uniaxial loading with in situ visualization of sample deformation. The acquired experimental data are utilized to validate a simulation model, ensuring its accuracy and reliability.

pmc-11621734.creator: Wahyu Triadmajani, Shinta Prawitasari, Abdul Wahab
pmc-11621734.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Background Exclusive breastfeeding (EBF) provides numerous health benefits to children. However, the EBF rate is unsatisfactory among young mothers because they often experience difficulties. Thus, interventions during the postnatal period are imperative to encouraging EBF practices in these populations.

pmc-12644813.description: Current theory of food web dynamics is based on mid- to long-term data.
